managed.description: Repositories that follow the shared scheme, keyed by name.

unmanaged.description: Repositories left alone, keyed by name, mapped to the reason.

label.description: Bazel label in the repository with an explicit target name, e.g. //site:public.

description.description: GitHub repository description. Omit when there is none.

wiki.description: Whether to enable the GitHub wiki.

build.description: Build and test system. Only bazel repositories receive Bazel updates or may set pages, tofu or bazel_updates.

required_checks.description: Job names of status checks required before merging a pull request into the default branch. May be empty.

direct_pushes.description: Whether commits may be pushed directly to the default branch without a pull request, for repositories whose own workflows commit there.

dependabot.description: Package ecosystems configured in the repository's hand-written .github/dependabot.yml.

pages.description: GitHub Pages site deployed from the default branch. Omit when there is none.

target.description: Bazel target whose output directory is the site.

tofu.description: OpenTofu root modules applied from the default branch, as tf_deploy targets.

bazel_updates.description: Inputs to the Bazel updates workflow that differ from its defaults.

skip_modules.description: Bazel module names to exclude from bazel_dep and git_override updates.

bazelversion_files.description: Paths to .bazelversion files to update together. Glob patterns are expanded.

auto_merge.description: Whether to enable squash auto-merge on opened pull requests.
